title: Üretken Ağlar ile Tabular Sentetik Veri Üretimi
summary: A capstone benchmarking project comparing resampling, GAN-based, and diffusion-based methods for tabular synthetic data generation on the Adult and Credit Card Fraud datasets, evaluated via statistical fidelity, detectability, and downstream ML efficacy. Among the GAN-based baselines, it trains SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and CopulaGANSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) as two of several generator families in the comparison.
